data.name: Damariel
data.gender_notes: Damariel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'damas' (tamed) and 'iel' (god). This name signifies a god-tamed individual, someone who has been subdued by the divine. The name Damariel carries the meaning “God's tamed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Damariel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's tamed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Damariel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's tamed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damariel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: דמריאל
in_hebrew.meaning: דברים של עוד-נחשב-לעז, דברים של נאמנות, כבוד, וכבוד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דמריאל (Damariel) - שם שמוצאו מדומַה, כבוד, נאמנות, ועז (Hebrew: דוֹמָה - כבוד, נאמנות, ועז). שם זה מוזכר בכתבי יד ישראלים, אך לא בטקסטים רשמיים. הפירוש הכללי של השם 'דמריאל' (Damariel) הוא 'אדם נאמן, ובעל כבוד', 'אדם עז, נאמן וכבוד', או 'אדם שנאמן וכבוד'.

in_greek.name: Δαμαριήλ
in_greek.meaning: λόγος της πίστεως, δόξα, τιμή, και πίστη
in_greek.long_meaning: Δαμαριήλ (Damariel) - όνομα που προέρχεται από τις αγγελικές γλώσσες και σημαίνει 'λόγος της πίστεως', 'δόξα', 'τιμή', και 'πίστη'. Στην πίστη, το όνομα Δαμαριήλ αναφέρεται σε έναν άντρα που προφανώς είχε μια στενή σχέση με το Θεό. Είναι ένας από τους σπάνιους ονόματα που φαίνεται να σχετίζεται με τις αγγελικές γλώσσες.

in_latin.name: Damariel
in_latin.long_meaning: Damariel - nomen quod oriundum est ex linguis angelicis, significat 'fides, gloria, honor, et fidelitas'. In fide, nomen Damariel refertur ad hominem qui videbatur habere habere prope Deum. Eius est unus ex raris nominibus quae videbantur habere relationem cum linguis angelicis.

in_english.name: Damariel
in_english.meaning: faith, glory, honor, and fidelity, name of an angel in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Damariel is a name that originates from angelic languages and means 'faith, glory, honor, and fidelity'. In Christian tradition, the name Damariel refers to an angel who is believed to have a close relationship with God. It is one of the rare names that appears to have a connection to angelic languages. The name may be associated with faith, trust, loyalty, honor, and glory, and may be suitable for parents who want to give their child a name with spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The Christian name Damariel conveys a sense of strength, submission, and faithfulness. It is reminiscent of biblical figures such as Daniel or Samson, who were called by God and went on to accomplish great things. Damariel may be seen as a reminder of the power of the divine to tame even the strongest of hearts or human experiences, imparting a unique blend of strength, humility, and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Damariel signifies a deep surrender to God's will and a trust that He will guide us through life's trials and tribulations. Its derivation from the Greek words 'damas' (tamed) and 'iel' (god) underscores the transformative power of the divine. It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining an open and submissive heart, allowing ourselves to be shaped and refined through the trials and challenges we face.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Damariel: God's tamed rebel. A name for those who, like the biblical character, Damascus Road Saul, experience a transformative encounter with the divine and dedicate their lives to the service of Christ.

biblical_reference.note: Not found in the Bible, but possibly derived from angelic names mentioned in the Bible

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Damariel was a 5th century Frankish king. The name Damariel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Damariel continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Damariel in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Damariel, which means "God's tamed". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
